meta.name: prisma-cli
meta.description: Prisma ORM CLI commands reference covering init, generate, migrate, db, dev, complete, studio, validate, format, debug, and mcp. Use for ORM/database CLI workflows, not the Prisma Platform CLI. Triggers on "prisma init", "prisma generate", "prisma migrate", "prisma db", "prisma complete", "prisma studio", "prisma mcp".

copy.tagline: 查阅数据库 ORM 命令,管理数据表结构与迁移
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常用命令行操作数据库,需要快速查找 Prisma 命令
copy.tagline_en: Look up database ORM commands to manage schemas and run migrations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with databases via CLI and need quick Prisma command references

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 能按内附的 Prisma ORM 命令参考回答问题：碰到 prisma init、migrate、db push 等操作时，会给出命令示例和风险提示；可能删数据的命令不会直接执行，会先请你明确同意。
howto.when: 当你提到「prisma init」「prisma migrate」这类 Prisma ORM 命令，或要求初始化项目、做数据库迁移、生成客户端时触发。它不覆盖 Prisma 平台（Platform）相关命令。

say.text: 帮我初始化一个用 PostgreSQL 的 Prisma 项目。
say.note: Claude 会给出带数据库参数的初始化命令。

say.text: prisma db push 会不会丢数据？
say.note: Claude 会说明风险，并要求你明确同意后再继续。

howto.what_en: After this skill is enabled, Claude answers Prisma ORM CLI questions using the bundled command reference: gives examples and risk notes for init, migrate, db push, etc. Destructive commands are only run after your explicit consent.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "prisma init"/"prisma migrate" or ask to initialize a project, run migrations, or generate the client. Not for Prisma Platform CLI.

say_en.text: Initialize a new Prisma project with PostgreSQL.
say_en.note: Claude shows the init command with the database option.

say_en.text: Create a migration named add_users with prisma migrate dev.
say_en.note: Claude gives the matching migrate dev command.

say_en.text: Will prisma db push lose data?
say_en.note: Claude explains the risk and asks for your consent first.
